stem.text: Two large parallel plates X and Y are placed a distance of $5.0\,\text{mm}$ apart and connected to the terminals of a $200\,\text{V}$ d.c. supply, as shown.

stem.alt: Two vertical parallel plates labelled X on the left and Y on the right, with a point P drawn between them. A double-headed arrow between the plates is labelled 5.0 mm. Both plates are connected by wires to a cell symbol labelled 200 V below them, forming a closed circuit.

stem.text: A small oil drop at P carries one excess electron.
What is the magnitude of the electrostatic force acting on the oil drop due to the electric field between the plates?
